usageNotes: Use this to inspect the network interface configuration of a specific node on a managed PVE remote — useful before provisioning VMs, validating bridge availability, or auditing SDN topology. The target node must be reachable by PDM and the caller needs Resource.Audit on the remote/node path. Use the 'interface-type' filter (e.g. 'bridge' or 'any_bridge') to narrow results when you only care about VM-facing bridges rather than the full interface list.

examples.summary: List all bridge interfaces on a PVE node to find available VM bridges

tips: The 'active' field reflects runtime state; 'exists' reflects whether the interface is physically present. An interface can exist but be inactive.
SDN-managed interfaces appear when 'interface-type' is set to 'include_sdn' or 'vnet' — omit the filter to see all types including SDN.
Results reflect the current on-disk /etc/network/interfaces config plus runtime state; pending unapplied changes may differ from what this returns.
Use 'any_bridge' to include both standard Linux bridges and OVS bridges in a single filtered call.
